dialog.english:
If we keep this up, we'll be able
to defeat the Dark Masters!
dialog.translation:
Si seguimos así, podremos
derrotar a los Amos Oscuros!

dialog.english: And peace will return to Earth!
dialog.translation: Y la paz volverá a la Tierra!

dialog.english: Okay, let's go!
I've had enough!
Huh? What did you say?

I've had enough of this. Why do we
have to keep fighting?!
dialog.translation:
Ya no aguanto más. Por qué
tenemos que seguir luchando?!

dialog.english: What...?

Tai, at least consider other
people's feelings for a bit!
dialog.translation:
Tai, piensa un poco en cómo
se sienten los demás!

dialog.english: And what do you mean by that?

You're right about what you just
said.
dialog.translation:
Tienes razón en lo que
acabas de decir.

dialog.english:
But you know, just because you're
right doesn't mean you can just
push aside people's feelings!
dialog.translation:
Pero que tengas razón
no significa que puedas
ignorar sus sentimientos!

dialog.english: Matt...

I know the only thing we can do is
to keep pushing forward...
dialog.translation:
Sé que lo único que podemos
hacer es seguir adelante...

dialog.english:
Don't you ever want to stop and
consider everything that's gong on
once in a while?!
dialog.translation:
Es que nunca quieres parar
y pensar en lo que está
pasando, aunque sea una vez?!

dialog.english: But we can't save the world this way
dialog.translation: Pero así no salvaremos el mundo

dialog.english: I understand how Mimi feels, too
We don't have time to sit around!
I *know* that!
Do you really?
Tai!
Please, stop. Everyone's upset.

We stand out too much as it is, so
let's move somewhere safer.
dialog.translation:
Llamamos mucho la atención,
mejor vamos a un sitio más seguro

dialog.english: (Was I wrong...?)
(Why won't Matt believe me...?)

(It's not like I'm wrong! Why
doesn't he get that?)
dialog.translation:
(No estoy equivocado! Por qué
no lo entiende?)

dialog.english:
(Soon we won't even have time to
rest, huh...)
dialog.translation:
(Pronto no habrá ni
tiempo para descansar...)

dialog.english: (What happened to Matt...?)

(At this rate, nobody's going to
be able to agree with each other
anymore...)
dialog.translation:
(Así, nadie va a poder
ponerse de acuerdo con los
demás nunca más...)

dialog.english:
(We have to find someplace to
rest...)
(Everyone's tired...)

Hey! Why don't we take a break for
a bit?
dialog.translation:
Oye! Por qué no descansamos un
poco?

dialog.english: I agree!
Yeah...
I should talk to everyone for a bit
dialog.translation: Debería hablar un poco con todos

dialog.english: We should get going and leave...

We have to stop Mimi from saying
too much, before she gets all of
us to start fighting.
dialog.translation:
Tenemos que evitar que Mimi
hable de más, antes de que
acabemos todos peleando.

dialog.english:
Right now we're in a bad
situation, so everyone's feeling
down.
dialog.translation:
Ahora mismo estamos mal,
así que todos están
un poco desanimados.

dialog.english:
Sorry, Tai. If we'd only been
stronger...
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Tai. Si hubiéramos
sido más fuertes

dialog.english:
You're already doing enough,
Agumon. Now we just have to work
together and survive.
dialog.translation:
Ya haces bastante,
Agumon. Ahora solo tenemos que
trabajar juntos y sobrevivir.

dialog.english: That's all we can do. I *know*.
dialog.translation: Es lo que podemos hacer. Lo sé.

dialog.english: Really?

Looks like there aren't any
enemies around here... I'd like it
to stay that way, but...
dialog.translation:
Parece que no hay enemigos
por aquí... Ojalá siga
así, pero...

dialog.english:
Sorry for making you worry,
Sora...

Everyone is anxious... It would be
better for us to know where the
enemy will move next, but...
dialog.translation:
Todos están nerviosos... Sería
mejor saber hacia dónde
se moverá el enemigo, pero...

dialog.english:
Yeah. But you should rest for now,
Izzy.
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero deberías descansar
un poco, Izzy.

dialog.english:
Ever since we came back to the
Digimon world, someone's always
been getting hurt...
dialog.translation:
Desde que volvimos al
Digimundo, siempre hay
alguien que sale herido...

dialog.english:
But we have to keep fighting, or
else both worlds will be in
danger...
dialog.translation:
Pero tenemos que seguir
luchando, o ambos mundos
correrán peligro...

dialog.english:
I know, but... I can't fight
anymore.
dialog.translation:
Lo sé, pero... no puedo
luchar más.

dialog.english:
Sorry, Tai... I've been saying
all these selfish things...
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Tai... he estado
diciendo tonterías egoístas...

dialog.english: Mimi...

Why does Matt keep getting into
fights with Tai...?
dialog.translation:
Por qué Matt sigue
peleándose con Tai...?

dialog.english:
The Dark Masters are all
Ultimates. The fight's only gonna
get harder...
dialog.translation:
Los Amos Oscuros son todos
Cuerpo Supremo. Va a ser
más difícil...

dialog.english:
Can't you evolve to Ultimate,
Gomamon?
dialog.translation:
No llegas a Cuerpo
Perfecto, Gomamon?

dialog.english:
If you keep pushing me like that,
it's only gonna get harder for me!
dialog.translation:
Si me sigues presionando así,
solo hará que me cueste
más!

dialog.english: Yeah, you're right...

I think everyone's tired because
they've been fighting for so long.
dialog.translation:
Creo que todos están
cansados de tanto luchar.

dialog.english:
Yeah, everyone seems to have
gotten tired of all the fighting.
dialog.translation:
Sí, parece que todos se
han cansado de tanto luchar.

dialog.english:
Let's do our best to not add onto
everyone's burdens.
dialog.translation:
Intentemos no ser una carga
para los demás.

dialog.english: Yeah, what Tailmon said.

I'm glad you're working hard, but
don't push yourself too much.
dialog.translation:
Me alegra que te esfuerces,
pero no te exijas tanto.

dialog.english:
It'll be fine! I'm your sister,
after all.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo! Soy tu hermana,
al fin y al cabo

dialog.english:
Guys! Let's hurry and get out of
here!

Tai, don't go deciding things
on your own. Can't you tell
everyone's tired?
dialog.translation:
Tai, no decidas las cosas
tú solo. No ves que todos
están cansados?

dialog.english:
Stop trying to be difficult all
the time!
What?!
Matt, don't fight with him...

At this rate, they'll get us! Our
enemies will be able to track us
down!
dialog.translation:
Así nos atraparán! Nuestros
enemigos podrán seguirnos
el rastro!

dialog.english: Now you just wait!
?! Tai... disappeared?
Where'd he go?
Mimi's gone, too!
Where are you, Mimi?
Sora?!
Izzy's up and vanished, too!
Joe?!
Kari?!
Everyone's gone...

T.K... I'll make sure to
protect you, and only you!
dialog.translation:
T.K... voy a protegerte
a ti, y solo a ti!

dialog.english:
Hey, Matt... How come you're
always giving me special
treatment?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Matt... Por qué siempre
me tratas de forma especial?

dialog.english: T.K?!

I came here so I could fight with
you. Am I really that unreliable?
dialog.translation:
Vine para luchar contigo.
Soy tan poco fiable?

dialog.english:
T.K... that's not what I
meant... I... what I wanted to say
was...
dialog.translation:
T.K... no quería decir
eso... yo... lo que quería
decir era...

dialog.english: What?
W...What?!
Huh?!
What just happened?

This must be... the work of the
enemy...
dialog.translation:
Esto debe de ser cosa
del enemigo...

dialog.english: Aaaaah! What's going on?!
Huh? Where's Tailmon?!
Aaaaaaaagh!
Tai!
Where'd everyone go?

Sitting around like this isn't
going to get us anywhere. Let's go
look for them!
dialog.translation:
Quedarnos aquí sentados no
nos lleva a ninguna parte.
Vamos a buscarlos!

dialog.english: Got it! I'll go look for T.K!
dialog.translation: Vale! Voy a buscar a T.K!

dialog.english: I'll... wait here...
Izzy, wait here with Mimi!

Understood! I'll leave the rest to
you all!
dialog.translation:
Entendido! Os dejo el resto
a vosotros!

dialog.english:
T.K, are you okay?! You're not
hurt anywhere, are you?
dialog.translation:
T.K, estás bien?! No te has
hecho daño, verdad?

dialog.english:
Hey, can you stop fussing so much
over me?
dialog.translation:
Oye, deja de agobiarte tanto
por mí?

dialog.english:
I can take care of myself, you
know!
Let's plaaaaay!
Who's...
Let's plaaaaay!
That voice is getting closer!
Let's play!
You're...!

If you lay even one finger on
T.K, I'll make you regret it!
dialog.translation:
Como le pongas un dedo
encima a T.K, te arrepentirás!

dialog.english:
Hmph, so your name's T.K? Hey,
do you wanna play war with me?
dialog.translation:
Vaya, así que te llamas T.K?
Quieres jugar a la guerra
conmigo?

dialog.english: T.K! Don't listen to him!
I don't care about you!
Ugh...!
Matt!
Okay, let's go.
N-No!

You don't wanna? Hmph...
It'll be boring without you…
dialog.translation:
No quieres? Hmph...
Será aburrido sin ti...

dialog.english:
Maybe I should kill this one over
here~!
dialog.translation:
Igual debería matar a
este de aquí~!

dialog.english: Don't!
So you'll come with me, then?

I'll go with you. That's all I
have to do, right?
dialog.translation:
Iré contigo. Es todo
lo que tengo que hacer, no?

dialog.english: T.K!
So now you have to come!

Hey, Sora. This place looks
familiar!
dialog.translation:
Oye, Sora. Este lugar me
suena!

dialog.english:
You're probably right... is this
the forest entrance?
dialog.translation:
Puede que tengas razón...
es la entrada del bosque?

dialog.english: Yeah, I think so!
Tai!
Sora!
Hey, it's you two!
Great job finding us!
I was following Tai's scent!

All right, let's go look for the
others.
dialog.translation:
Vale, vamos a buscar a
los demás.

dialog.english: Yeah!

Tai, wrong way! We have to find
the others!
dialog.translation:
Tai, al revés! Hay que
encontrar a los demás!

dialog.english: Sorry, sorry! I'm coming!
Tai!
Sora!
I'm glad you're safe!
Good, good! Let's find the others!
dialog.translation:
Bien, bien! Busquemos a
los demás!

dialog.english: Okay. First, let's play tag!

Hurry up and run! Otherwise it's
boring!
dialog.translation:
Corre rápido! Si no, qué
aburrido!

dialog.english: O-Okay!
Who's that?
I wonder who he is?

Must be a one of Lord
Pinocchimon's new toys.
dialog.translation:
Debe de ser un juguete
del Señor Puppetmon

dialog.english: Hey, hey! Has T.K come by here?
dialog.translation:
Oye, oye! Ha pasado T.K
por aquí?

dialog.english: T.K? Ah, he went that way...
dialog.translation: T.K? Ah, se fue por ahí...

dialog.english: He's not here!
I could have sworn he was just...
Liar!!
Ugh...
Gh...
Man, you grate on my nerves!
Man, you grate on my nerves!

This is most likely the work of
the Dark Masters.
dialog.translation:
Esto seguro que es cosa
de los Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english:
They're probably planning a
divide-and-conquer...
dialog.translation:
Seguro que quieren
dividirnos para vencer...

dialog.english:
That means we have to hurry up and
join up with the others!
dialog.translation:
Hay que reunirse con los
demás cuanto antes!

dialog.english: Yeah!

Huh...? We were just here not too
long ago...
dialog.translation:
Eh...? Si hace nada
estábamos aquí...

dialog.english:
There's something strange about
this forest! No matter where we
go, the landscape looks familiar.
dialog.translation:
Este bosque tiene algo raro!
Vayamos donde vayamos, el
paisaje nos resulta familiar.

dialog.english:
Do you think... we might be being
led astray?

Yeah... let's keep going, and
let's be careful!
Ughhhh! What's going on?!

It seems like if we don't proceed
on the correct route, we'll be
sent back to where we were before.
dialog.translation:
Parece que si no vamos por
el camino correcto, volvemos
al punto de partida.

dialog.english:
So if we go back, we'll eventually
be able to go forward?
dialog.translation:
Entonces si volvemos atrás,
al final podremos avanzar?

dialog.english:
This isn't working... Izzy,
is there any way we can go?
dialog.translation:
Esto no funciona... Izzy,
hay alguna forma de avanzar?

dialog.english:
Got it, Tai! Proceed in the
order of → ↓ ← ↑ !
dialog.translation:
Vale, Tai! Hay que seguir
el orden → ↓ ← ↑ !

dialog.english: Ugh! We ended up back here.

Please calm down, Tai. The
correct route is → ↓ ← ↑ .
dialog.translation:
Cálmate, Tai, por favor. La
ruta correcta es → ↓ ← ↑ .

dialog.english: It's Joe and Kari!
Tai!

Ah... thank goodness you're here,
Tai! We've been wandering
around in circles for a while.
dialog.translation:
Ah... menos mal que estás
aquí, Tai! Llevamos un rato
dando vueltas.

dialog.english:
Huh? Really? We haven't gotten
lost at all, but...
dialog.translation:
En serio? No nos hemos
perdido para nada, pero...

dialog.english:
Well, it's good that we ran into
each other by accident!

Anyway, now we just have to find
Matt and T.K.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, ahora hay que
encontrar a Matt y T.K.

dialog.english:
Yes... I'm worried about Matt
and T.K. Let's hurry!
dialog.translation:
Sí... me preocupan Matt
y T.K. Vamos rápido!

dialog.english: Aaaah!!
Aaaaaaaaaaah!
Heh heh heh...

Okay, let's start with your legs!
Huh? I'm out of ammo...
dialog.translation:
Vale, empecemos por tus
piernas! Eh? Me quedé sin
balas...

dialog.english:
(If I don't do something, I'll be
done for! I've got to do
something! Something...)
dialog.translation:
(Si no hago algo, estoy
perdido! Tengo que hacer
algo! Algo...)

dialog.english:
Man, this is getting really
boring...
What did you just say?!

We've just been doing the same
thing over and over again. You're
surprisingly boring.
dialog.translation:
Llevamos haciendo lo mismo
una y otra vez. Eres
sorprendentemente aburrido.

dialog.english:
What?! Nobody's ever said that to
me before, not even once!
dialog.translation:
Qué?! Nadie me había dicho
eso antes, ni una vez!

dialog.english:
Huh... Could it be that you don't
have any friends?
dialog.translation:
Eh... Será que no tienes
amigos?

dialog.english: I-I have friends!

Okay. So can I meet these
so-called friends?
dialog.translation:
Vale. Puedo conocer a esos
supuestos amigos?

dialog.english: Not right now!

Huuuuuh? So you really don't have
them after all, right?
dialog.translation:
Eeeeh? Entonces no los
tienes de verdad, no?

dialog.english:
I do! I'll bring them right now,
so wait here!
dialog.translation:
Sí que tengo! Los traigo
ahora, espera aquí!

dialog.english: T.K!
Patamon!
I'm so glad you're safe, T.K!
dialog.translation: Menos mal que estás bien, T.K!

dialog.english:
Ah! By the way, on my way here, I
saw a room with a weird machine in
it.
dialog.translation:
Ah! Por cierto, de camino
vi una sala con una máquina
rara.

dialog.english:
Really?! That must be the device
that separated us!
dialog.translation:
En serio? Ese debe ser
el aparato que nos separó!

dialog.english: Let's break it on our way out!
Got it! This way, T.K!

We're finally out of that winding
forest! Now where are Matt and
T.K...
dialog.translation:
Por fin salimos de ese
bosque laberíntico! Dónde
estarán Matt y T.K...

dialog.english:
Why don't we try going a bit
further?
dialog.translation:
Por qué no seguimos un
poco más?

dialog.english: Yeah! Let's do that!
Matt!
Matt...
Ugh... Unf... Tai...

Tai, Gabumon... T.K...
T.K's been taken away by
Pinocchimon!
dialog.translation:
Tai, Gabumon... T.K...
Se han llevado a T.K,
se lo llevó Puppetmon!

dialog.english: What?!
We have to go save him!

Where are Pinocchimon and T.K
now?
dialog.translation:
Dónde están Puppetmon
y T.K ahora?

dialog.english: I have no idea!
Matt, keep yourself together!
Huh?!

It's Lord Pinocchimon's playtime
right now. Do not disturb him!
dialog.translation:
Es la hora de jugar del Amo
Puppetmon. No lo molestéis!

dialog.english: Hey! Where's T.K?!
Hahaha...
Hey! Answer me!

Matt, right now we have to
defeat them!

You don't understand how I feel at
all! Gabumon, evolve!
dialog.translation:
No sabes cómo me siento!
Gabumon, digievoluciona!

dialog.english: ...O-Okay!
What are you doing?!

I've been trying to evolve for a
while now, but I can't!
dialog.translation:
Llevo un rato intentando
evolucionar, pero no puedo!

dialog.english: W-What?!
Gyehhhhhh!
Matt...!
Aaaaaaaaaah!

What did you just do?! Now that
you've defeated him, we won't be
able to find out where T.K is!
dialog.translation:
Qué has hecho?! Ahora que
lo has derrotado, no
sabremos dónde está T.K!

dialog.english: Calm down, Matt!
Heeeeey!
Huh?
T.K?
Hey, guys! I'm back!

See, I can protect myself just
fine!
Great job making it back here!
Wow!

We broke the mechanism that had
separated us!
dialog.translation:
Rompimos el mecanismo que
nos separaba!

dialog.english: Nice, T.K! Great job!
...Huh? Where's Matt?
He was right there just now...

He broke my toys... and he
escaped...

And he said he doesn't want to
play with me... Fine, I get it...
dialog.translation:
Y dijo que no quiere jugar
conmigo... Vale, lo entiendo...
